meta.title: MVC-100355-Switch heating modes while streaming(Heating is OFF)
meta.description: Switch through the heating modes while a stream runs and the heating stays off, including a rejected control value
meta.author: Ehu Li

result.description: Preconditions
SW config 10C1 (rcam_2): service port 30501, SD 239.120.1.1:30490, 8 ROIs, Tauto 15.0/20.0 degC, Tprotection 45.0/40.0 degC
Production data Volvo_Standard_1Gbit_SN00012803.py: MAC 98:d3:d2:00:32:03, serial 00012803, hwVer 01H-
Open point 1: subscribe payload 0xC000003 has seven digits, used is 0xC0000003.
Open point 2: Request ID 0x0000000F on the unsubscribe only, used is 0x12345678.
Open point 3: the subscribe response is specified as length 0x0C without payload, that would be 0x08.
Open point 4: the steps wait a fixed hour per chamber setpoint, here Timager decides when the DUT has arrived.
Open point 5: the steps require Tambient > Tauto_off. The firmware switches on Timager, so Timager is checked as well.
Open point 6: 'check RTP stream' does not say how. The test listens on the port the parameter set defines and treats one received packet within 2.0 s as an active stream.
